# Feature: Visual project dashboard (SPEC-016)

> **Version shipped:** 0.21.0  
> **QA verdict:** PASS (139/139 tests, 0 failures)  
> **Read-only release** — PRD milestones M1–M3. Write-back (M4) is a separate spec.

The dashboard is a **local, real-time web UI** that visualises the entire planning
artifact graph in `.planr/`. It surfaces the same data that `/planr-pipeline:status`
reports — hierarchy, dependencies, and statuses — as six interactive views, and
stays in lockstep with the filesystem via Server-Sent Events. The markdown files
remain the single source of truth; the dashboard is a read-only projection of them.

## Out of scope in this release

- Write-back: editing or reordering artifacts from the GUI (PRD M4, separate spec)
- Authoring new artifacts in the GUI (remains `/plan` and the CLI)
- Multi-user, cloud, or hosted deployment
- AI features inside the dashboard
